Meet Brooo

The real Brooo — from our team's own app

In the Brooo app, Brooo is an AI companion for teens. When something seems off, it checks in first. When you need space, it stays quiet. Here in Brooo: Firsts, the very same Brooo is your guide across California Youth Civic Island, cheering you on as you finish each of life's firsts, one real step at a time.

    How to Play

    1. 1
      Pick an islandUse the Map pins or the List view — each island is one of life's firsts.
    2. 2
      Read the island overviewSee the real steps, requirements, and a quick fact before you play.
    3. 3
      Work through the First MissionEach mission is a checklist of real-life steps. Every step shows you how to do it, links to the official resource, and lets you mark it as completed — every step earns 20 Civic XP.
    4. 4
      Collect your stampCheck off every step and complete the mission to stamp that island in My First Passport and unlock badges.
    Levels: Novice Citizen → Curious Explorer (120 XP) → Civic Pathfinder (300 XP) → Island Guardian (450 XP) → Civic Champion (600 XP).
    Self-reported: completion is checked off by you, so stamps show as “Self-reported.” Civic XP is a Brooo achievement record, not an official certification — “Officially Verified” stamps are a future feature.
